'''Izhsmash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] data thief who was incarcerated in the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. Izhsmash was the second-in command to the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Strabo]], leader of the prison gang [[Gravity Massive]]. When [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], using the name Jagannath, was sent by his master, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], to the prison to acquire a weapon from [[Iram Radique]], Maul had him hack into the Cog Hive Seven database looking for info on every [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]], which included their criminal histories. Maul later had Izhmash hack into an algorithm to arrange a fight between Maul and the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] convict [[Rook]]. Izhsmash was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and his body was shown to Maul by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inmate [[Dakarai Blirr|Zero]], actually Dakarai Blirr undercover. As a message to whoever found the body, Izhsmash's [[Eye/Legends|eye]] sockets and [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] had been stuffed with twisted wire and pieces of broken circuit board.

==Behind the scenes==
Izhsmash is abbreviation of [[Wikipedia:Kalashnikov Concern|Izhevsk Machinebuilding Plant]] in Russian.
